description: Inline WYSIWYG editing for LaTeX: formulas and formatting rendered right in the editor, source revealed under the cursor.
command.toggleDocument: Pause / resume rendering for this file
config.languages.description: Language identifiers where rendering applies (add "markdown" for $…$ formulas in Markdown).
config.renderMath.description: Replaces formulas ($…$, \[…\], equation, align…) with their rendering.
config.renderTables.description: Replaces tables (tabular, tabular*, tabularx) with their rendering.
config.renderFormatting.description: Applies formatting (\textbf, \emph, \section, \textcolor, \href…) and replaces \ref, \cite, \label and \footnote with short text, hiding the commands.
config.renderImages.description: Shows a preview of \includegraphics images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, SVG; not PDF or EPS).
config.revealOn.description: When to show the LaTeX source instead of the rendering.
config.color.description: CSS color of formulas (empty: derived from the light or dark theme).
config.revealOn.cursor: The source reappears when the cursor or selection touches the element.
config.revealOn.line: The source reappears for the whole line holding the cursor.
